justification: Inspected `byte-buddy-dep/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/dynamic/scaffold/MethodGraph.java` and the dedicated tests `byte-buddy-dep/src/test/java/net/bytebuddy/dynamic/scaffold/MethodGraphNodeSimpleTest.java`, `MethodGraphNodeUnresolvedTest.java`, and `MethodGraphNodeListTest.java`. `Node` is a small interface with only 4 abstract methods (`getSort`, `getRepresentative`, `getMethodTypes`, `getVisibility`) plus a compact nested `Sort` enum and two tiny nested implementations (`Unresolved`, `Simple`) with trivial behavior. The tests are split by concern and exercise these small roles separately, which does not show excessive size, many methods, or low cohesion for the class itself.
